Toddler meals

Apple peanut quinoa

Almás mogyorós quinoa

6 months+ Replaced 25 min 2 portions

Once tolerated, about two teaspoons of smooth peanut butter, thinned, three times a week. Never a spoonful of thick peanut butter.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 50 g Quinoa (Rinsed well)
  • 1 small Eating apple (Peeled, cored, and grated)
  • 250 ml Water (Enough to cook the grains fully soft)
  • 1 teaspoon Smooth peanut butter (Thin it in yogurt before it goes in the bowl)
  • 30 g Plain full-fat yogurt (Pasteurized; used to thin the peanut butter)

Allergens

peanutmilk

Method

  1. Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in the water until every grain is soft.
  2. Stir in the grated apple and cook until the apple is soft.
  3. Stir the peanut butter into the yogurt until the mixture is thin.
  4. Fold that thin mixture through the warm quinoa.
  5. Mash so no dry grains remain, and cool to serving temperature.

Replaced

The usual dish waited until 11 or 12 months and used dry puffed quinoa, which is easy to inhale. A baby with severe eczema or an egg allergy needs medical advice before the first peanut taste.

Cook the quinoa until soft, or use oats and then add gluten to the allergens. Thin a teaspoon of smooth peanut butter with yogurt or the cooking liquid, then fold in grated cooked apple.
